title: doronicum columnae subsp. carpaticum
intro: Doronicum columnae subsp. carpaticum, commonly known as the Carpathian leopard's bane, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is a perennial herb native to the Carpathian Mountains, used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The plant is believed to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and improving digestion. The bioactive constituents of Carpathian leopard's bane include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
